designationHistory.indexText: President Theodore Roosevelt created the Boise National Forest in Idaho from part of the Sawtooth National Forest.
designationHistory.note: The executive order text was not located online. FS-612 and the 1944 WPA list of executive orders (compiled from the orders) agree on EO 857 of June 26, 1908; Davis gives the effective date, July 1, 1908. On Apr. 1, 1944 (PLO 217, 9 F.R. 3655) the old Payette National Forest was added to Boise; that consolidation is treated here as a boundary change.
